programme.title: 36 Secrets Of Courtship
programme.desc: Three lotharios vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School, an extremely non-monastic institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Fight Back To School
programme.desc: A SWAT team leader is forced by his captain to go undercover as a high school student to retrieve the captain's personal gun which was stolen during a school field trip to the police station.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his older brother Ma Tai Chueng arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Be-friending a powerful mobster Wing Jing is given his nightclub in return for saving Tam Sei’s life. Unfortunately, another Gangster wants the territory a well.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Chow stars as Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: The story revolves around a dutiful yet indifferent fireman, who can march into disaster and risk his lives by saving others, yet would he have the equivalent courage to tackle his personal issues?

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed.

programme.title: The Case Of Disappearances
programme.desc: When Qing Cheng was a teenager, he was attacked by an unknown mutant monster and lost his family and memory. He was regarded by the villagers as an ominous person who would bring disaster.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon 2
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: Before winning action-film acclaim with their daring stunts, these stars endure years of blood, sweat, and tears training under the ruthless Master Yu.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: A Monkey King is reincarnated in the un human form as Joker, a highwayman oblivious to his original identity and the fact that 500 years earlier, he and his master, the Longevity Monk, were punished and made to stay human.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: For five years, 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete Toyota AE86 every morning and because of that, he has become a good racer and also unwillingly perfected the art of drifting.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: Anita Yuan Yung-yi stars as an illegitimate daughter who inadvertently finds a pearl with a genie in it. Michael Wong is the genie who gives her three wishes, leading to a lot of hilarity and even a little heartbreak.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: The film revolves around a woman in her late twenties who rediscovers her talent for boxing after a long hiatus. She unexpectedly meets her former boxing coach and the pair work together to help her reach the final rounds of professional boxing matches.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing quits the force after getting demoted to traffic duties, while his partner is assigned a mission involving foreign terrorists threatening to bomb a school in Hong Kong, so Sing decides to help by going undercover at the same school.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows.

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: An evil warlord takes in 2 students (Wind And Cloud) in an effort to become invincible so he can take over the world.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Valentino is a mediocre con artist who crosses paths with Kwan, a fellow con artist. Together, they impersonate various people and create numerous schemes to make money. Meanwhile, gangsters are making a scheme of their own.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: A rich old man and a sexy young photographer compete for a stunning young gym instructor. The younger man is clearly winning until the rich man offers a deal.

programme.title: Young Heroes Of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: A failed assassination attempt in Harbin, China in 1909 changes the course of history. Now two JBI agents must find the connections between it and an ancient Korean artifact.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: Hero Wah goes to study under Master Pride. When he returns to his parents, he learns that they have been murdered by a band of evil Westerners. After impregnating his wife Jade, he ventures to New York in search of his parents' killers.

programme.title: Love On Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: A simple Chinese immigrant wages a perilous war against one of the most powerful criminal organizations on the planet.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Cinderella
programme.desc: The convoluted continuation of the adventures of the time-traveling, now-human Monkey King, who attempts to fulfill his divine destiny.

programme.title: Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. His pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan.

programme.title: Alone We Fight
programme.desc: Facing mounting odds, a small but determined band of American soldiers venture into dangerous enemy territory on a mission to stop an advancing German unit from breaking through the Allied line.

programme.title: The Curse Of The Clown Motel
programme.desc: When Alma returns home to help her family get their Native American heritage recognized, all she finds is the World-Famous Clown Motel that has been erected on their land.

programme.title: Havenhurst
programme.desc: A troubled young woman takes up residence in a gothic apartment building where she must confront a terrifying evil.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: A farmer takes in an injured man with a satchel of cash. When a posse comes for the money, he must decide who to trust. Defending a siege, he reveals a gunslinging talent calling his true identity into question.

programme.title: The Pig Farmer
programme.desc: Award-winning investigation into the crimes of Robert Pickton. This documentary explores why it took so many years to capture and convict Canada's most prolific serial killer. Troubling revelations about who knew what, and when.

programme.title: Darkness Of Man
programme.desc: Interpol operative Russell Hatch witnesses the death of an informant when a seemingly routine raid goes wrong. Years later, he finds himself protecting the informant's son from a group of merciless gangs involved in an all-out turf war.

programme.title: Traded
programme.desc: In the 1880s western Traded, a father must leave his ranch for Dodge City to save his daughter from an old enemy, putting his reputation as the fastest draw in the west to the test.

programme.title: Hunting Games
programme.desc: When a group of ex-military members is hired to retrieve a lost bag of stolen money, their mission becomes more difficult after a lone hunter finds the bag first.

programme.title: Death On The Border
programme.desc: Two determined women vie to escape their abusive relationships with a dirty Detective at rock bottom, determined to move sex trafficked girls over the Mexican border.

programme.title: Wunderland
programme.desc: Lt. Cappa and his American infantry platoon are ordered to defend a vital road junction against a German offensive in the Battle of the Bulge. Despite difficult winter conditions, they must hold their position to stop the German advance.

programme.title: Road To Hell
programme.desc: A soldier who has been fighting a long war is driven mad because he no longer believes in any purpose or righteous truth behind the killing. He comes home to a surreal world looking for his first and only love from his youth, believing she will rescue him from his demons. On the road to Edge City he encounters two seductive spree killers who oppose his efforts to find his love and the redemption he desperately seeks.

programme.title: Phoenix
programme.desc: Jean Grey begins to develop incredible powers that corrupt and turn her into a Dark Phoenix, causing the X-Men to have to decide if her life is worth more than all of humanity.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: An unassuming young lawyer leads a fight against the Nazis near the end of World War II.

programme.title: Another Mother's Son
programme.desc: Lou lives on the Nazi-occupied Island of Jersey during World War 2. She accepts to hide a young Russian POW at her house at the risk of being imprisoned herself and takes care of him as if he was her own son.

programme.title: Outlaws And Angels
programme.desc: When outlaws on the lam invade the home of an unsuspecting, seemingly innocent, frontier family to hide out for the night, an unexpected game of cat and mouse ensues, leading to seduction, role reversal, and ultimately, bloody revenge.

programme.title: In Isolation
programme.desc: Four friends wanted to get away in a remote country house but when a mysterious man turns up and telling tales of a city ravaged by a epidemic and the looters who have pursued him, the friends rally to help.

programme.title: The Price We Pay
programme.desc: After a pawn shop robbery goes askew, two criminals take refuge at a remote farmhouse to try to let the heat die down, but find something much more menacing.

programme.title: The Last Champion
programme.desc: When his mother dies, scandal-ridden ex-Olympian John Wright returns to a hometown that has not forgiven him.

programme.title: Riot
programme.desc: Cop Jack Stone robs a Russian mob bank to end in the same prison as the mob boss killing Jack's wife. An inmate helps him as does a reporter. Lots of fights.

programme.title: Candy Land
programme.desc: A seemingly naive and devout young woman navigates her way into the underground world of truck stop sex workers a.k.a. lot lizards.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: American gangster Erik Vasquez is scheming to become the top dog in the Mexican underworld, only to find himself making enemies out of both the powerful cartels and his own allies.

programme.title: A Tale Of Two Guns
programme.desc: In the lawless West, a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves called The Cowboys reigns over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate finally catches up with them.

programme.title: The Fourth State
programme.desc: A German journalist investigating the Russian secret service gets caught up in a terrorist plot in Moscow.

programme.title: Pups Alone
programme.desc: While everyone is away on a company ski trip, Robert's neighbor hires two inept thieves to steal his latest invention. The neighborhood dogs will use Robert's inventions to set up a house of horrors for the thieves.

programme.title: Operation Seawolf
programme.desc: The German Navy and the last remaining U-Boats, were formed together for one last mission to attack the United States Homeland.

programme.title: Alone We Fight
programme.desc: Facing mounting odds, a small but determined band of American soldiers venture into dangerous enemy territory on a mission to stop an advancing German unit from breaking through the Allied line.

programme.title: The Ballad Of Davy Crockett
programme.desc: In 1815, an American Legend, whose wife has fallen deathly ill, leaving his young children to survive on their own, must fight his way back to them across the many perils found in the Savage Lands of the wild frontier.

programme.title: Gravy
programme.desc: It's All Hallow's Eve. A trio of costumed misfits with very special dietary requirements seizes a Mexican cantina and force the staff to engage in a late night of gaming, food and libations. The only caveat is what's on the menu.

programme.title: The 5th Wave (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Four waves of increasingly deadly alien attacks have left most of Earth in ruin. Cassie is on the run, desperately trying to save her younger brother.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Damnation (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Special Agent Leon S.Kennedy goes against his superior's orders and works to destroy a series of biological weapons being used in a war zone in Europe.

programme.title: The Forest (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: An American woman enters Japan's legendary Suicide Forest in search for her twin sister, who has mysteriously disappeared.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: A failed reporter is bonded to an alien entity, one of many symbiotes who have invaded Earth. But the being takes a liking to Earth and decides to protect it.

programme.title: The Craft: Legacy
programme.desc: A group of high school students form a coven of witches.

programme.title: Testament Of Youth
programme.desc: A British woman recalls coming of age during World War I - a story of young love, the futility of war, and how to make sense of the darkest times.

programme.title: Terminator Salvation
programme.desc: Set in post-apocalyptic 2018, John Connor is the man fated to lead the human resistance against Skynet and its army of Terminators.

programme.title: The Intruders
programme.desc: After the traumatic loss of her mother, a teenaged girl tries to uncover the dark secrets behind her new home, in spite of her father's disbelief.

programme.title: Bad Boys For Life
programme.desc: Miami detectives Mike Lowrey and Marcus Burnett must face off against a mother and son pair of drug lords who wreak vengeful havoc on their city.

programme.title: Armored
programme.desc: A newbie guard for an armored truck company is coerced by his veteran coworkers to steal a truck containing $42 million. But a wrinkle in their supposedly foolproof plan divides the group, leading to a potentially deadly resolution.

programme.title: Superbad
programme.desc: Two co-dependent high school seniors are forced to deal with separation anxiety after their plan to stage a booze-soaked party goes awry.

programme.title: The International
programme.desc: Clive Owen stars as an Interpol agent who attempts to expose a high-profile financial institution's role in an international arms dealing ring.

programme.title: Sex Tape
programme.desc: A married couple wake up to discover that the sex tape they made the evening before has gone missing, leading to a frantic search for its whereabouts.

programme.title: Passengers (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: A malfunction in a sleeping pod on a spacecraft traveling to a distant colony planet wakes one passenger 90 years early.

programme.title: Chappie (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: In the near future, crime is patrolled by a mechanized police force. When one police droid, Chappie, is stolen and given new programming, he becomes the first robot with the ability to think and feel for himself.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Vendetta (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Chris Redfield enlists the help of Leon S. Kennedy and Rebecca Chambers to stop a death merchant from spreading a deadly virus in New York.

programme.title: Total Recall (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Life changes for factory worker, Douglas Quaid, after visiting Rekall, a company that implants memories of a life its clients would have liked to have led and finds himself on the run.

programme.title: Men In Black: International
programme.desc: The Men in Black have always protected the Earth from the scum of the universe. In this new adventure, they tackle their biggest, most global threat to date: a mole in the Men in Black organization.

programme.title: The Night Before
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve, three lifelong friends spend the night in New York City looking for the Holy Grail of Christmas parties.

programme.title: She's Funny That Way
programme.desc: On the set of a playwright's new project, a love triangle forms between his wife, her ex-lover and the call-girl-turned-actress cast in the production.

programme.title: The 5th Wave
programme.desc: Four waves of increasingly deadly alien attacks have left most of Earth decimated. Now Cassie needs to prepare for the 5th wave while trying to save her brother.

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: A cab driver finds himself the hostage of an engaging contract killer as he makes his rounds from hit to hit during one night in Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: An American woman enters Japan's legendary Suicide Forest in search for her twin sister, who has mysteriously disappeared.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: A failed reporter is bonded to an alien entity, one of many symbiotes who have invaded Earth. But the being takes a liking to Earth and decides to protect it.

programme.title: Blumhouse's Fantasy Island
programme.desc: When the owner and operator of a luxurious island invites a collection of guests to live out their most elaborate fantasies in relative seclusion, chaos quickly descends.

programme.title: Proud Mary
programme.desc: Mary is a hit woman working for an organized crime family in Boston, whose life is completely turned around when she meets a young boy whose path she crosses when a professional hit goes bad.

programme.title: Zathura: A Space Adventure (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Two young brothers are drawn into an intergalactic adventure when their house is hurled through the depths of space by the magical board game they are playing.

programme.title: The Other Guys (Galaxy Premium)
programme.desc: Two mismatched New York City detectives seize an opportunity to step up like the city's top cops, whom they idolize, only things don't quite go as planned.

programme.title: Go Go Bus
programme.desc: Serial Animasi Bercerita Tentang Bus Sekolah-Gordon Akan Berubah Menjadi Kendaraan Yang Berbeda Seperti Pemadam Kebakaran, Ambulans, Polisi, Pesawat Dan Penyelamatan Untuk Membantu Anak-Anak Yang Memiliki Masalah. Sementara Itu, Ia Membimbing Anak-Anak Untuk Memahami Diri Mereka Sendiri Dan Membuka Pikiran Mereka. Serta Mengarahkan Anak-Anak Untuk Mengeksplorasi Kehidupan Yang Bermakna, Membantu Mereka Fokus Pada Tugas Yang Ada Dan Belajar Mengelola Emosi Yang Mengganggu Mereka.

programme.title: Bread Barbershop

Bread Dan Keluarganya Siap Membantu Para Selebriti Untuk Menemukan Lagi Kebahagiaan Mereka.

programme.title: Will Sliney'S Storytellers
programme.desc: Menceritakan Petualangan Freya, Seorang Gadis Pembuat Peta Viking Yang Pemberani, Bersama Ogham, Sebuah Batu Melayang Ajaib Yang Jenaka. Mereka Mengemban Misi Perjalanan Lintas Waktu Untuk Mengumpulkan Tim Seniman Muda Berbakat Guna Menghentikan Penjahat Licik Bernama The Chronicle Dan Antek-Anteknya. The Chronicle Berencana Untuk Mencuri Dan Menguasai Seluruh Karya Seni Paling Terkenal Di Dunia.

programme.title: Smurfs
programme.desc: Di Tengah Hutan Belantara, Terdapat Desa Rahasia Dihuni Oleh Sekelompok Makhluk Kecil Berwarna Biru Yang Dipimpin Oleh Papa Smurf. Para Smurf Tinggal Di Rumah Berbentuk Jamur Dan Hidup Dengan Damai. Namun, Kedatangan Penyihir Jahat Gargamel Dan Kucingnya, Azrael, Merusak Kedamaian Desa Tersebut. Sehingga Para Smurf Harus Mencari Cara Agar Tidak Ditangkap Oleh Gargamel Dan Azrael.

programme.title: Blox Buster
programme.desc: Blox Buster Adalah Program Entertainment Yang Menghadirkan Keseruan Bermain Di Dunia Roblox, Platform Game Populer Dengan Jutaan Kreasi Dari Komunitas Global, Penonton Diajak Menjelajahi Berbagai Dunia Virtual Yang Penuh Warna, Menantang, Sekaligus Menyenangkan. Tidak Hanya Sekadar Bermain, Main Bareng Blox Juga Menyuguhkan Pengalaman Unik Dari Para Gamers Yang Ikut Serta, Mulai Dari Review Game, Tips Seru, Hingga Momen-Momen Kejutan Yang Terjadi Saat Bermain.

programme.title: Tawa Satwa
programme.desc: Program Yang Menampilkan Kompilasi Video Lucu Hewan Yang Viral Di Media Sosial Dan Di-React Secara Kekinian Oleh Voice Over Talent Dengan Karakter Beragam Yang Akan Menambah Kelucuan.

programme.title: Super Wings
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Perjuangan Jett Dan Timnya Dalam Melindungi Bumi Dan Luar Angkasa Dari Golden Boy, Yang Berhasil Mencuri Sumber Energi Kosmik Kuat Bernama Star Core. Dengan Kekuatan Star Core, Golden Boy Melompati Dimensi Ruang-Waktu Dan Mengancam Keseimbangan Alam Semesta. Untuk Menghentikannya, Tim Super Wings Harus Meluncurkan Markas Besar Ruang Angkasa Mereka, Menjelajahi Berbagai Dimensi Ekstrem, Hingga Terlibat Dalam Pertempuran Robot Raksasa Demi Merebut Kembali Energi Tersebut Dan Menyelamatkan Dunia.

programme.title: We Bare Bears Iv
programme.desc: Menceritakan Usaha Lucu Dan Canggung Dari Tiga Beruang Bersaudara, Grizzly, Panda, Dan Ice Bear Dalam Beradaptasi Dengan Dunia Manusia Modern Serta Mencari Teman.

programme.title: Quantum Heroes Dinoster
programme.desc: Empat Sahabat Bernama Lucio, Delby, Jay Min, Dan Oz Melakukan Perjalanan Rahasia Ke Bumi Dinosaurus Untuk Menyelamatkan Para Dinosaurus Dari Bahaya, Mereka Disebut Tim Dinoster. Petualangan Mereka Dibantu Oleh Seorang Ilmuwan Kuantum Yaitu Professor Laura. Mereka Bersama-Sama Berusaha Untuk Melindungi Dinosaurus Dari Bahaya Alam Dan Bex Hunter, Seorang Ilmuwan Yang Ingin Membuat Dinosaurus Melawan Manusia.

programme.title: Bread Barbershop

programme.title: Adit Sopo Jarwo
programme.desc: Animasi Indonesia, Berisikan Kisah Kehidupan Sehari-Hari Masyarakat Indonesia Yang Dipenuhi Dengan Pengetahuan, Kelucuan, Kisah Persahabatan, Serta Nilai Persatuan, Kesatuan, Dan Kebudayaan. Tokoh Dalam Cerita Ini Diantaranya Adit (Tokoh Utama, Seorang Anak Laki-Laki), Adelya (Adik Adit), Teman-Teman Adit Yakni Dennis, Mitha, Dan Devi. Mereka Harus Berhadapan Dengan Duo Orang Dewasa (Sopo & Jarwo) Yang Selalu Mencari Celah Untuk Mendapat Keuntungan Tanpa Usaha. Perbedaan Paham Atau Cara Pandang Merupakan Bumbu Utama Yang Memicu Perseteruan Dan Kelucuan. Beruntung Di Antara Mereka Ada H. Udin, Ketua Rw Bijaksana Yang Selalu Menjadi Penengah Dan Memberikan Petuah Bijak Yang Disampaikan Dengan Ringan Serta Lugas Sehingga Mampu Mengembalikan Suasana Gaduh Menjadi Teduh.

programme.title: Ejen Ali
programme.desc: Ali Dan Para Agen Junior Lainnya Diundang Untuk Mengikuti Turnamen Tingkat Tinggi Bernama M.A.T.A. Arena. Turnamen Ini Mempertemukan Mereka Dengan Para Agen Senior Serta Agen-Agen Hebat Dari Luar Cyberaya. Tanpa Bantuan I.R.I.S., Ali Harus Berjuang Mengandalkan Kemampuan Dan Latihan Aslinya Untuk Membuktikan Diri. Di Sisi Lain, Muncul Ancaman Baru Serta Intrik Dari Kelompok Numeros Dan Pergerakan Rizwan Yang Penuh Misteri.

Dipandu Oleh Tiga Host Utama Yaitu Komandan Zack, Bro Dim, Dan Miss Binal, Setiap Episodenya Juga Menghadirkan Berbagai Cameo Menarik Seperti Tahanan, Petugas Kebersihan, Hingga Karakter Unik Lainnya Yang Menambah Keseruan. Dengan Gaya Penyajian Yang Ringan, Menghibur, Dan Penuh Humor, Ijin, Ndan Tetap Konsisten Menyampaikan Fakta Aktual Dan Pesan Edukatif Kepada Penonton, Menjadikannya Tontonan Yang Informatif Sekaligus Mengundang Tawa.

programme.title: Adit Sopo Jarwo
programme.desc: Animasi Indonesia, Berisikan Kisah Kehidupan Sehari-Hari Masyarakat Indonesia Yang Dipenuhi Dengan Pengetahuan, Kelucuan, Kisah Persahabatan, Serta Nilai Persatuan, Kesatuan, Dan Kebudayaan. Tokoh Dalam Cerita Ini Diantaranya Adit (Tokoh Utama, Seorang Anak Laki-Laki), Adelya (Adik Adit), Teman-Teman Adit Yakni Dennis, Mitha, Dan Devi. Mereka Harus Berhadapan Dengan Duo Orang Dewasa (Sopo & Jarwo) Yang Selalu Mencari Celah Untuk Mendapat Keuntungan Tanpa Usaha. Perbedaan Paham Atau Cara Pandang Merupakan Bumbu Utama Yang Memicu Perseteruan Dan Kelucuan. Beruntung Di Antara Mereka Ada H. programme.title: Ejen Ali
programme.desc: Ali Dan Para Agen Junior Lainnya Diundang Untuk Mengikuti Turnamen Tingkat Tinggi Bernama M.A.T.A. Arena. Turnamen Ini Mempertemukan Mereka Dengan Para Agen Senior Serta Agen-Agen Hebat Dari Luar Cyberaya. Tanpa Bantuan I.R.I.S., Ali Harus Berjuang Mengandalkan Kemampuan Dan Latihan Aslinya Untuk Membuktikan Diri.
